p: Abram went up out of Egypt: His great riches gotten in Egypt, did not hinder him in following his vocation.
Bethel: He calls the place by the name which was later given to it, Ge 23:19.
bear them: This inconvenience came by their riches, which break friendships and the bounds of nature.
Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then: Who seeing their contention, might blaspheme God and destroy them.
strife: He cuts off the opportunity for contention: therefore the evil ceases.
take the left hand: Abram resigns his own right to buy peace.
garden of the LORD: Which was in Eden, Ge 2:10.
one from the other: This was done by God's providence, that only Abram and his seed might dwell in the land of Canaan.
sinners before the LORD exceedingly: Lot thinking to get paradise, found hell.
Abram: The Lord comforted him, lest he should have taken thought for the departure of his nephew.

ever: Meaning a long time, and till the coming of Christ as in Ex 12:14,21:6, De 15:17 and spiritually this refers to the true children of Abram born according to the promise, and not according to the flesh, which are heirs of the true land of Canaan.
